title: Hastings Lake Gardens

services.name: Our Greenhouse
services.desc: Immerse yourself in a greenhouse oasis with over 40 years of family-run expertise at Hastings Lake Gardens. Our seasoned team of friendly and knowledgeable staff are dedicated to assisting you in all your gardening endeavors. Whether you’re envisioning a new yard, planning a garden, or simply selecting bedding plants, a visit to Hastings Lake Gardens is a gardening essential. Spanning 16,000 sq. feet, our greenhouses are conveniently located just 20 minutes east of South Edmonton and Sherwood Park.
